name: svg-french-press-glm-5.3-flashx-v2-s1-r4
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="700" height="1060" viewBox="0 0 700 1060">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="steel" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8d949c"/>
      <stop offset="0.35" stop-color="#e8ecf0"/>
      <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#b8bfc7"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7c838b"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#cfdbe2" stop-opacity="0.85"/>
      <stop offset="0.3" stop-color="#eef6fa" stop-opacity="0.5"/>
      <stop offset="0.7" stop-color="#b9c9d2" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#9fb2bd" stop-opacity="0.85"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="black" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#1e2126"/>
      <stop offset="0.4" stop-color="#4a5058"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#23262b"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect width="700" height="1060" fill="#f7f4ee"/>
  <text x="350" y="60" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="26" fill="#333">French Press — Exploded Assembly</text>

  <!-- center axis -->
  <line x1="350" y1="110" x2="350" y2="1000" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="6 6"/>

  <!-- 1. Knob -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="130" rx="42" ry="16" fill="url(#black)"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="122" rx="42" ry="16" fill="#3a4048"/>
    <rect x="308" y="122" width="84" height="8" fill="url(#black)"/>
    <text x="420" y="130" font-family="Arial" font-size="15" fill="#444">1. Knob</text>
  </g>

  <!-- dashed connector -->
  <line x1="350" y1="150" x2="350" y2="200" stroke="#aaa" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 5"/>

  <!-- 2. Lid -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="232" rx="120" ry="22" fill="url(#black)"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="224" rx="120" ry="22" fill="#464d56"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="222" rx="120" ry="22" fill="url(#black)"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="222" rx="26" ry="6" fill="#111418"/>
    <text x="500" y="228" font-family="Arial" font-size="15" fill="#444">2. Lid</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="350" y1="252" x2="350" y2="310" stroke="#aaa" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 5"/>

  <!-- 3. Plunger rod -->
  <g>
    <rect x="344" y="305" width="12" height="280" rx="4" fill="url(#steel)"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="305" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#dfe4e9"/>
    <text x="250" y="450" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial" font-size="15" fill="#444">3. Plunger rod</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="350" y1="595" x2="350" y2="630" stroke="#aaa" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 5"/>

  <!-- 4. Filter assembly (three-piece: top cross plate, mesh, base plate) -->
  <g>
    <!-- top cross/spiral plate -->
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="652" rx="95" ry="18" fill="url(#steel)"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="648" rx="95" ry="18" fill="#d3d9df"/>
    <path d="M258 646 Q350 618 442 646" fill="none" stroke="#9aa2ab" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M262 654 Q350 630 438 654" fill="none" stroke="#9aa2ab" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="342" y="642" width="16" height="10" rx="2" fill="#6b737c"/>

    <!-- mesh disc -->
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="684" rx="93" ry="17" fill="#c9ced4" stroke="#7f868e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <g stroke="#8b929a" stroke-width="0.8">
      <line x1="258" y1="682" x2="442" y2="682"/>
      <line x1="262" y1="676" x2="438" y2="676"/>
      <line x1="262" y1="690" x2="438" y2="690"/>
      <line x1="272" y1="671" x2="428" y2="671"/>
      <line x1="272" y1="696" x2="428" y2="696"/>
      <line x1="300" y1="668" x2="300" y2="700"/>
      <line x1="350" y1="667" x2="350" y2="701"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="668" x2="400" y2="700"/>
    </g>

    <!-- base retaining plate -->
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="716" rx="88" ry="16" fill="url(#steel)"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="712" rx="88" ry="16" fill="#cfd5db"/>
    <circle cx="300" cy="712" r="4" fill="#7d848c"/>
    <circle cx="400" cy="712" r="4" fill="#7d848c"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="700" r="4" fill="#7d848c"/>

    <text x="480" y="690" font-family="Arial" font-size="15" fill="#444">4. Filter assembly</text>
    <text x="480" y="708" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#777">(plate · mesh · plate)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- 5. Carafe -->
  <g>
    <!-- glass beaker body -->
    <path d="M225 785 L225 930 Q225 950 250 950 L450 950 Q475 950 475 930 L475 785 Q475 763 450 761 L250 761 Q225 763 225 785 Z"
          fill="url(#glass)" stroke="#8fa3ad" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <path d="M240 775 L240 935" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-opacity="0.7" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="761" rx="112" ry="14" fill="none" stroke="#8fa3ad" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <!-- spout -->
    <path d="M225 777 L200 765 L200 781 L225 791 Z" fill="url(#glass)" stroke="#8fa3ad" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- handle -->
    <path d="M475 790 Q540 797 540 905 Q540 940 480 940" fill="none" stroke="url(#black)" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="150" y="800" font-family="Arial" font-size="15" fill="#444">5. Carafe</text>
  </g>

  <!-- 6. Base / cage bottom -->
  <g>
    <path d="M245 1020 L245 1013 Q245 1003 258 1003 L442 1003 Q455 1003 455 1013 L455 1020 Z" fill="url(#black)"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="1003" rx="107" ry="10" fill="#3c434b"/>
    <text x="580" y="1015" font-family="Arial" font-size="15" fill="#444">6. Base</text>
  </g>

  <!-- assembly arrow -->
  <g stroke="#b0562f" stroke-width="2.5" fill="#b0562f">
    <line x1="130" y1="180" x2="130" y2="830"/>
    <path d="M123 820 L130 838 L137 820" fill="none"/>
    <text x="118" y="530" transform="rotate(-90 118 530)" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#b0562f" stroke="none">assembly direction</text>
  </g>
</svg>
